derived_from: Ahrefs Keywords Explorer, country=tr, 2026-10-05. 60 keywords across the connectivity and travel-information halves, recorded in ahrefs-tr-TR-market-admission-2026-10-05.json and in this file.
why_a_separate_file: The 2026-10-02 table is dated evidence for ten languages and stays byte-identical. Turkish was measured three days later, so it goes in its own dated file and the loader merges the two. Editing a dated measurement to add rows measured on another day would make its own date a lie about half its contents.
rule: Unchanged from the 2026-10-02 table: a destination country earns a language only when BOTH a connectivity keyword and a travel-information keyword carry volume in it. One alone is not enough.
the_bar_and_where_it_comes_from: The 2026-10-02 table states "carry volume" without a number, so the bar is read off what it actually ADMITTED: its lowest qualifying connectivity volumes are IS/de at 40 and SI/it at 50, and every refusal in it is for ZERO information volume, never for a low connectivity volume. So 40 is the bar, applied here unchanged. Holding Turkish to a higher bar than the one German and Italian were admitted on would be the inconsistency, not the fix.
what_the_turkish_measurement_shows_that_: In Turkish the eSIM intent is GENERIC, not per-country. esim nedir reads 5,800, esim nasil alinir 5,100, yurtdisi internet paketi 1,000, yurtdisinda internet kullanimi 600, while the per-country phrasing tops out at 100: ingiltere sim kart 100, dubai esim 100, yunanistan esim 90, gurcistan esim 70, japonya esim 70. German and English behave the opposite way - esim japan reads 5,400 in en-AU, esim albania 3,400 in it-IT. This is a fact about how Turkish speakers word the query, not about whether they travel: yunanistan vize reads 17,000 and karadag gezilecek yerler 6,000. It is why eleven countries clear the bar here and why seven with large travel volume do not.

ES|tr.why_not: the connectivity keyword "ispanya esim" reads 30 a month, below the 40 that the lowest QUALIFYING pair in the 2026-10-02 table was admitted on (IS/de at 40, SI/it at 50). The travel-information half is strong here - "ispanya gezilecek yerler" 3,600, "barselona gezilecek yerler" 2,400 - and that is not enough on its own: the rule asks for both halves and this country has one. Refused on the SAME bar the other ten languages were measured against.
